caption: The drawing features a pattern of stylized floral and leaf motifs primarily in red, green, and yellow colors, arranged on a rectangular area with a light background filled with faint, intricate, grayish line patterns and crosshatching. At the top and bottom edges, there are wavy, green stems with attached leaves and clusters of small, red, droplet-like flowers. Throughout the central area, there are large, red flower shapes with bulbous petals and green stems, each accented with green leaves and round, yellow centers. Additional smaller red and green floral elements appear, connected by gently curved stems and interspersed with large, light green leaves with red accents. The composition is symmetrical, with repeating floral forms and leaves distributed in a grid-like or mirrored arrangement, and the background is filled with circular and spiral motifs in soft gray.
title: Quilt - Tulip Design
